# Amazon Web Services (AWS)

> > Amazon Web Services provides comprehensive cloud computing platforms and services including AI/ML, infrastructure, and enterprise solutions to customers worldwide including Mercedes-Benz, Pinterest, Condé Nast, and government entities.

AWS is the world's most comprehensive cloud platform, offering over 200 fully featured services from data centers globally. The platform serves enterprises, governments (including AWS GovCloud), and developers across regions including the United States, Canada, Mexico, Chile, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and beyond.

## Key Topics

- Cloud Computing
- AWS Global Infrastructure
- Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
- Neural Networks (Sinir Ağı)
- Deep Learning (Derin Öğrenme)
- Enterprise Cloud Solutions
- AWS GovCloud
- Video Conferencing
- Customer Stories
- Innovation
- Image Processing (Görüntü İşleme)
- Speech Recognition (Konuşma Tanıma)
- AI Services

- [Cloud Computing Services - Amazon Web Services (AWS)](https://aws.amazon.com/): AWS homepage showcasing cloud computing services and customer stories
- [Video Conferencing & Online Meetings - Amazon Chime](https://aws.amazon.com/chime/): Amazon Chime video conferencing product and SDK for developers
